finding: Framework advertises __NUXT_DATA__ as navigable page data, but treats Nuxt's devalue reference table as ordinary JSON; selecting 7.repo therefore extracts the reference index 10 as {value:10}, while slot 10 carries nuxt/nuxt in the reported native page.
evidence_provenance: The native worker reported 108 serialized entries and the 7.repo/slot-10 mismatch on https://nuxt.com/docs/4.x/getting-started/introduction; this read-only lane traced source but did not repeat browser execution.
intended_behavior: FrameworkTab promises a navigable tree, a selected key path, extractable rows and saved replay; docs/feature-tests.md:1248-1258 explicitly include __NUXT_DATA__. Nuxt documents devalue serialization at https://nuxt.com/docs/4.x/getting-started/data-fetching; devalue documents indexed references and parse/unflatten at https://github.com/sveltejs/devalue.
root_cause: framework-dump.ts:22-29 JSON.parse feeds raw serialized entries to the picker; modes/next-data.ts:185-190,287-290 JSON.parse feeds the same raw entries to runInPage; lines 335-349 traverse the raw array and convert a selected number into {value:number}. No Nuxt revival occurs at either boundary.
classification: Supported source with misleading extraction semantics, not a malformed JSON or missing-data case. JSON.parse successfully parses the transport encoding but does not reconstruct its object graph.
sibling_census: nextDataMode.detectInPage and page-diagnostic.ts:157-171 mark parseable __NUXT_DATA__ as available and page-diagnostic.ts:382-389 recommends Framework; FrameworkTab preview and saved next_data patterns both use the raw runner, so the same failure persists on replay. Other script sources use ordinary JSON in this path; no proof here that they share Nuxt's reference encoding.
minimal_correction: Decode __NUXT_DATA__ with Nuxt/devalue-compatible revival at the common page-source seam before tree display and extraction, keeping identical decoded path semantics for preview and saved replay; preserve strict no-eval handling and report unsupported custom types visibly rather than presenting reference indexes as rows.
required_guard: A real Nuxt serialized payload whose selected property references a later slot must show the resolved value in the tree, extract it, and return the same value after pattern save/replay; assert ordinary JSON sources remain unchanged. Fail this guard before the change and pass after, then repeat on the native nuxt.com page.
limit: No product fix or runtime test in this lane; the native report is external evidence, and this source trace establishes the causal path conditional on that payload.
